_opis: Wspolna biblioteka strojow (od 2026-10-07, zdjecia od usera, twarze/napisy wyciete). waga = jak czesto losowac; ulubiony = 3 zaznaczone przez usera. plik=null -> tylko opis (wymyslone w tym stylu).

stroje.nazwa: Gorset w prążki + sznurowane kozaki za kolano
stroje.opis_en: a black pinstripe corset minidress: a boned overbust corset with silver eyelets and black lacing down the front, a short layered ruffled skirt of black satin with frilled trim; long black lace-up arm sleeves; black leather leg-harness straps with silver rings on both thighs; black lace-up thigh-high platform boots with criss-cross lacing and chunky studded platform soles; layered silver chain and rosary necklaces

a black faux-leather corset top with wide shoulder straps and silver front clasps; a short tiered ruffled black miniskirt with frilled openwork trim and ribbon ties; long black openwork fingerless gloves; black tights with an openwork floral pattern; black knee-high lace-up platform boots with thick soles; two small black bows in the hair

stroje.nazwa: Gorset z kolcami + różaniec + mikro szorty
stroje.opis_en: a black leather corset top with a scalloped black trim along the neckline, rows of long silver cone spikes on the straps and along the sides and silver chains hanging down the sides; a long black-bead rosary with a skull-and-crossbones medallion and silver rings; black denim micro shorts with silver star studs; black thigh-high stockings with patterned tops and cross-shaped garter clips

stroje.nazwa: Koronkowy gorset + ćwiekowane pasy + mikro szorty
stroje.opis_en: a black bustier corset top with floral openwork panels, cropped above the navel; long black openwork sleeves; frayed black denim micro shorts; two low-slung silver pyramid-and-spike studded belts; black thigh-high socks with a spiked leather garter band on one thigh; a silver cross pendant

stroje.nazwa: Czarny top + plisowana mini z klamrami
stroje.opis_en: a fitted black off-shoulder long-sleeve top with silver cross charms at the cuffs; a very short black pleated skirt with a wide waistband of silver eyelets, small spikes and buckled straps; a long silver chain with a large cross pendant; a black leather thigh strap with a silver buckle

stroje.nazwa: Kopertowy crop top + mini w kratę + podwiązki
stroje.opis_en: a black puff-sleeve wrap crop top with a deep V-neckline edged in frilled trim, tied under the bust; a short black-and-white tartan pleated skirt with lace-up sides; long black ribbed arm warmers; black thigh-high stockings with a floral openwork pattern and suspender straps under the skirt

a burgundy satin boned overbust corset top; high-waisted black leather shorts with lace-up sides and a square-buckle belt; black tights with an openwork floral pattern; black chunky multi-buckle platform combat boots to mid-calf; a black studded slouchy shoulder bag; a thin silver chain choker with a small cross

a black studded cabbie cap; a black halter top with a deep V-neck, a buckle strap and a keyhole cut-out; a very short grey washed-denim pleated skirt with a double black studded belt; thin semi-opaque black tights with black ribbed knee socks; shaggy brown faux-fur boot covers with straps; a black shoulder bag with a small white plush bunny charm; a black choker with a silver cross
a short white satin dress with thin spaghetti straps, a fitted bodice and a flared double-layer ruffled skater skirt; black over-the-knee socks; a thin silver necklace

stroje.nazwa: Halter z dekoltem + dzwony + pas z oczkami
stroje.opis_en: a black halter crop top with a deep plunging neckline, a silver ring keyhole and an eyelet-studded band under the bust; low-rise black flared trousers with a wide black eyelet belt; chunky black platform shoes; a black velvet choker with a small cross

a black lace-up overbust corset over a very short red tartan pleated skirt with silver chains at the hip; black diamond-net tights; black knee-high buckled platform boots; a spiked black leather choker; black openwork fingerless gloves

a glossy black vinyl corset top with buckle straps; a short black pleated vinyl skirt; a black leather leg harness with silver O-rings on one thigh; thin semi-opaque black thigh-high stockings; black platform Mary Jane shoes with ankle straps; long black openwork gloves

a short black velvet corset dress with a sweetheart neckline, front lacing and a ruffled frilled hem; black diamond-net stockings; black lace-up thigh-high platform boots; a large silver cross on a long chain

stroje.nazwa: Siateczka + ćwiekowany gorset + obroża z kolcami
stroje.opis_en: a black net-knit long-sleeve top under a studded black bustier; a short black asymmetric ruffled skirt with safety pins and hanging chains; ripped black diamond-net tights; a spiked collar; black platform creepers

stroje.nazwa: Biały gorset + czarna tiulowa mini + podwiązki
stroje.opis_en: a white satin lace-up corset top with black frilled trim; a short black ruffled tulle skirt; black thigh-high stockings with a floral openwork pattern and garter straps; black knee-high platform boots; a black ribbon choker with a silver cross

stroje.nazwa: Skórzany gorset w ćwiekach + mini z rozcięciem
stroje.opis_en: a black leather corset covered in silver pyramid studs; a short black leather skirt with a side slit and silver chains; black diamond-net tights; black knee-high buckled platform boots; studded leather arm cuffs; a long rosary necklace

stroje.nazwa: Fioletowy aksamitny gorset + podkolanówki w paski
stroje.opis_en: a deep purple velvet corset top with black frilled trim; a short black tiered ruffled skirt; purple-and-black striped thigh-high socks; black buckled platform boots; black openwork fingerless gloves

stroje.nazwa: Krótka marynarka w prążki + koronkowy bustier
stroje.opis_en: a cropped black pinstripe blazer worn open over a black bustier with floral openwork; a short black pinstripe pleated skirt with silver chains; thin semi-opaque black thigh-high stockings with garter straps; black lace-up platform boots; a black ribbon choker

stroje.nazwa: Satynowy gorset na siateczce + szorty z łańcuchami
stroje.opis_en: a black net-knit long-sleeve top under a black satin corset with silver hook clasps; black micro shorts with two studded belts and hanging chains; black lace-up thigh-high boots with chunky heels; layered silver cross necklaces
